candidates.cp_b_title_en: Banking sector inherent vulnerability to money laundering and involvement in all three stages

cp_a.reason: Identifies inherent risk factors: criminal misuse, international nature, immediacy, large amounts.

units.zh: 电汇可被用于向犯罪分子转移资金，存在风险。
units.en: Wire transfers carry risk because they can be used to send money to criminals.

units.zh: 电汇具有国际性，更易用于跨境转移资金。
units.en: They are international, which makes them more attractive to use to send money across jurisdictions.

units.zh: 电汇可即时到账且难以撤销，增加风险。
units.en: Wire transfers can send funds immediately, and it can be difficult to reverse a transaction.

units.zh: 电汇可转移大额资金，风险更高。
units.en: They can also transfer a large amount of funds, which makes them riskier.

cp_b.title_zh: 银行业固有洗钱风险与参与洗钱三阶段
cp_b.title_en: Banking sector inherent vulnerability to money laundering and involvement in all three stages
cp_b.reason: Unit 411 makes the core claim; units 412-414 provide context and risk indicators, and units 415-417 detail the three money laundering stages that demonstrate why banks are involved and thus vulnerable.

units.zh: 银行业因可参与洗钱所有三个阶段而固有地更易受洗钱风险影响
units.en: The banking sector is inherently more vulnerable to money laundering than other industries as banks can be involved in all three stages of the money laundering cycle.

units.zh: 银行每日处理数百万笔交易，其中许多是快速跨境资金转移
units.en: Banks are responsible for conducting millions of transactions a day. Many of these transactions are rapid transfers of funds that could include cross-border movements.

units.zh: 动态的银行环境为洗钱者提供了将非法资金混入合法资金中的众多机会
units.en: This dynamic environment offers numerous opportunities for money launderers to disguise illicit funds among legitimate ones.

units.zh: 某些银行产品和服务的复杂性和精密性进一步增加了洗钱风险
units.en: The complexity and sophistication of certain banking products and services further increases this risk.

units.zh: 洗钱的处置阶段：非法资金通过银行存款或购买金融工具进入金融系统
units.en: Placement of illicit funds into the financial system might occur through bank deposits or purchase of monetary instruments.

units.zh: 洗钱的离析阶段：资金通过多个账户和交易转移以掩盖其来源
units.en: During layering, the funds are moved through various accounts and transactions to obscure their origins.

units.zh: 洗钱的融合阶段：清洗后的资金通过投资或商业活动以看似合法的形式重新进入经济
units.en: Finally, in the integration stage the laundered funds re-enter the economy as seemingly legitimate funds through investments or business ventures, again facilitated by banks.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Purpose and Notification for Customer Due Diligence Meetings

cp_a.title_zh: 提交可疑活动报告的要求
cp_a.reason: These units collectively outline the key rules for submitting a SAR, forming a single review point about SAR requirements.

units.zh: 提供清晰的沟通、基于证据的分析和严格的合规协议以支持调查。
units.en: Provide clear communication, evidence-based analysis, and strict compliance protocols to support investigations.

units.zh: 使用标题、要点和逻辑顺序简化复杂细节。
units.en: Use headings, bullet points, and logical sequencing to simplify complex details.

units.zh: 使用简明英语，突出矛盾（如陈述目标与交易不符）以证明担忧合理。
units.en: Write in plain English and highlight contradictions, such as stated goals versus transactions, to justify concerns.

units.zh: 及时提交报告并避免通风报信。
units.en: Submit reports promptly and avoid tipping off.

units.zh: 提交 SAR 时的关键要点列表引导。
units.en: When submitting a SAR:

cp_b.title_zh: 客户尽职调查会议的目的与通知
cp_b.title_en: Purpose and Notification for Customer Due Diligence Meetings
cp_b.reason: Introduces the necessity of customer engagement for due diligence and covers jurisdictional and advisory notification requirements, forming a coherent initial-stage review point.

units.zh: 必要时需与客户接触以收集尽职调查或调查所需的额外信息，通常由客户经理等面向客户的员工进行。
units.en: At times it will be necessary to engage with customers to gather additional information for due diligence or investigative purposes. Customer-facing employees, such as relationship managers, typically conduct these meetings, as they might already have a relationship with the customer.

units.zh: 某些司法管辖区要求提前通知客户机构将收集信息。
units.en: Some jurisdictions require advanced notification to customers that the organization will collect information.

units.zh: 即使未要求，也建议提前通知客户并说明数据用途，以减少客户疑虑。
units.en: Even if not required, providing this notice is advisable, as it helps reduce the impression that the organization is asking unnecessary questions. It is also advisable to tell the customer how the data will be used.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Organizational Reporting Policies and Officer Appointment

cp_a.title_zh: 政治敏感人物分类类型

units.zh: 外国政治敏感人物包括外国政府官员，如国家元首、高级政客、军事领导人、司法官员及国有企业高层。
units.en: Foreign PEPs include officials in foreign governments, such as heads of state, senior politicians, military leaders, judicial officials, and high-ranking members of state-owned enterprises.

units.zh: 国内政治敏感人物包括在机构运营所在国担任高级公职的官员。
units.en: Domestic PEPs include officials who hold a high public office within the country of an organization’s operation.

units.zh: 国际组织政治敏感人物包括联合国、国际货币基金组织、世界银行等全球实体的高管和董事会成员。
units.en: International organization PEPs are executives and board members of global entities, such as the UN, International Monetary Fund, and World Bank.

units.zh: 不同司法管辖区和监管机构将政治敏感人物分为以下类别。
units.en: Different jurisdictions and regulatory bodies classify PEPs into the following categories:

cp_b.title_zh: 组织报告政策与官员任命
cp_b.title_en: Organizational Reporting Policies and Officer Appointment
cp_b.reason: Outlines the need for policies and the appointment of compliance officers for reporting, with titles listed as support.

units.zh: 组织应有明确定义的政策和程序，确保报告清晰、基于事实并保护相关员工。
units.en: However, an organization will have clearly defined policies and procedures to ensure reporting is clear and factual and to protect the relevant employees.

units.zh: 全球范围内，组织任命官员负责金融犯罪防控项目并报告可疑金融犯罪。
units.en: Around the world, organizations appoint officers to be responsible for AFC programs and to report suspicions of financial crime.

units.zh: 官员头衔示例包括首席合规官、反贿赂反腐败官、反洗钱官、洗钱报告官等。
units.en: The title might be chief compliance officer, anti-bribery and corruption officer, AML officer, money laundering reporting officer, principal officer, chief anti-money laundering compliance officer, or a title reflective of the jurisdiction.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Quality Control (QC) in First and Second Lines

cp_a.title_zh: 第一和第二道防线的质量控制 (QC)
cp_a.title_en: Quality Control (QC) in First and Second Lines
cp_a.reason: Units 2452-2457 cover QC definition, examples, and procedures, forming a coherent QC review point.

units.zh: 第一道和第二道防线通常执行质量控制（QC）和质量保证（QA），QC检查产出质量，QA评估流程有效性。
units.en: Both the first and second lines of defense typically perform quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA). QC focuses on inspecting the quality of outputs, while QA evaluates how effective the organization's processes are, especially in compliance and risk management.

units.zh: 第一道防线运营团队的最佳实践是自动化身份验证、筛查和风险评分等任务。
units.en: For example, in the first line of defense operations team, it is considered best practice to automate tasks such as identification and verification checks, screening, and risk scoring.

units.zh: 开户时创建的了解你的客户档案通常整合客户详细信息与风险评级。
units.en: A KYC file created during onboarding usually consolidates the customer's details and risk rating.

units.zh: 第二人进行四眼检查以确保准确性。
units.en: A second person conducts a four-eyes check to ensure accuracy.

units.zh: QC职能可抽样检查文件，确认了解你的客户文档质量一致且可接受。
units.en: The QC function might include a sample of files to confirm that KYC documentation's quality is consistent and acceptable.

units.zh: 若质量下降，团队应修正不良产出，并为相关员工提供额外培训与支持。
units.en: If quality declines, teams should fix poor outputs and provide additional training and support to the staff involved.

cp_b.title_zh: 平衡有效性与客户体验
cp_b.reason: Core review point on the need to balance AFC technology effectiveness with customer experience, aligning with risk appetite.

units.zh: 选择技术时，机构必须在有效性与客户体验之间取得平衡。
units.en: When selecting technology, institutions must balance effectiveness with customer experience.

units.zh: 稳健系统提升合规与风险管理，但过度侵入性流程可能导致负面客户体验。
units.en: Robust systems improve compliance and risk management, but overly intrusive processes can lead to negative interactions.

units.zh: 安全与便利的权衡应与机构风险偏好一致，确保控制措施与风险水平相称。
units.en: The trade-off between security and convenience should align with the organization’s risk appetite, ensuring controls are proportionate to the level of risk.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Organizational setup for law enforcement communication
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Decision-making quality and documentation in governance

cp_a.title_zh: 与执法部门沟通的组织设置
cp_a.title_en: Organizational setup for law enforcement communication
cp_a.reason: These two units both describe organizational practices—designating a point of contact and having written procedures—forming a single review point about communication setup.

units.zh: 大多数组织指定专人作为与执法部门的联络点。
units.en: Most organizations designate a specific person to serve as the point of contact with law enforcement.

units.zh: 组织应制定书面程序，规定如何回应执法部门的正式信息请求。
units.en: Organizations should have written procedures that address how to communicate with law enforcement when responding to formal requests for information.

cp_b.title_zh: 治理中的决策质量与文件记录
cp_b.title_en: Decision-making quality and documentation in governance
cp_b.reason: Addresses committee decision-making, the risk of poor information, check-and-challenge processes, and documentation requirements for audit readiness.

units.zh: 委员会必须评估信息并决定组织的正确行动方案。
units.en: Committees must assess this information and decide on the right course of action for the organization.

units.zh: 组织应记录关键决策及其理由、风险评估、利益相关方意见和合规考量，以备审计和监管审查。
units.en: Organizations should document key decisions, including rationale, risk assessments, stakeholder input, and compliance considerations. By documenting accountability and the decision-making process, organizations are better prepared for scrutiny from internal audits and regulators.

units.zh: 均衡参与和多元视角可提升委员会决策有效性。
units.en: Balanced participation and diverse perspectives enhance committee effectiveness.

units.zh: 信息不清晰或不正确可能导致错误决策，违背战略利益。
units.en: Poor decisions can arise from unclear or incorrect information, potentially leading to actions that contradict strategic interests.

units.zh: 实施强有力的质疑与挑战流程有助于缓解决策风险。
units.en: Implementing strong check-and-challenge processes helps mitigate this risk.

cp_a.reason: Penalties for failing to file a SAR, with a concluding reminder to follow regulations.

units.zh: 未提交SAR可能导致金融机构面临罚款、监管限制甚至监禁等重大处罚。
units.en: Failure to file a SAR can lead to substantial penalties for the financial institution, including fines, regulatory restrictions, or even imprisonment.

units.zh: 必须遵守所在司法管辖区的法规，因各地法规存在差异。
units.en: Make sure you follow the regulations in your jurisdiction, as regulations vary.

cp_b.reason: Covers the definition and importance of regulatory reporting, including jurisdictional variation and non-compliance penalties.

units.zh: 监管报告是全球金融机构确保金融犯罪防控合规、金融透明和风险缓解的关键义务
units.en: Regulatory reporting is a critical obligation for financial institutions worldwide, ensuring compliance with AFC laws, financial transparency, and risk mitigation.

units.zh: 各司法管辖区有独特的报告规则、截止日期和披露要求。
units.en: Each jurisdiction typically enforces unique reporting rules, filing deadlines, and disclosure requirements.

units.zh: 不合规会导致严重罚款、声誉损害和监管执法行动。
units.en: Non-compliance can lead to severe financial penalties, reputational harm, and regulatory enforcement actions.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Adverse Media Screening: Definition and Mandate

cp_a.title_zh: 负面媒体筛查：定义与要求
cp_a.title_en: Adverse Media Screening: Definition and Mandate
cp_a.reason: Defines adverse media checks and mandates a risk-based approach.

units.zh: 负面媒体检查（不良新闻筛查）用于识别与金融犯罪风险相关的公开信息
units.en: Adverse media checks—also known as negative news screening— identify publicly available information linking individuals or entities to financial crime risks.

units.zh: 金融机构须对负面媒体筛查采取基于风险的方法，确保准确可信
units.en: With the increasing de-escalation of fact-checking on social media platforms, and the rise of automated software-as-a-service screening solutions, financial institutions must take a risk-based approach to adverse media screening, ensuring accurate and credible risk assessments.

cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 支付筛查在交易完成前识别高风险个人和实体，包括客户和交易对手。
units.en: Payment screening identifies high-risk individuals and entities, including the institution’s customers and the transaction counterparties, before transactions are completed.

units.zh: 姓名筛查在开户前及持续通过批量筛查将客户姓名与制裁名单等观察名单比对。
units.en: Name screening identifies individuals who might be at higher risk for involvement in financial crime. It screens customers’ names against watchlists including sanctions lists. It occurs prior to onboarding and on an ongoing basis through batch screening.

units.zh: 支付或交易筛查审查客户收付款项，若匹配制裁名单则暂停并调查。
units.en: Payment or transaction screening reviews payments made and received by customers. It reviews payments made to or from parties on sanctions lists. If a match is detected, it is stopped and held until investigations are complete.

units.zh: 负面媒体筛查审查客户、受益所有人、股东或关联方的负面新闻。
units.en: Adverse media screening reviews negative news about a customer, beneficial owner, shareholder, or associated party, such as regulatory fines or investigations.

units.zh: 政治敏感人物筛查审查客户姓名、付款详情、负面媒体及与政治敏感人物的关联。
units.en: PEP screening reviews customer names, payment details, adverse media, and connections to PEPs.

units.zh: 列举几种筛查类型。
units.en: There are several types of screening, including:

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Singapore's National AML Strategy and Risk-Based Approach
candidates.cp_b_title_en: National Risk Assessment (NRA): Threats and Enhanced Measures

cp_a.title_zh: 新加坡国家反洗钱战略与风险为本方法
cp_a.title_en: Singapore's National AML Strategy and Risk-Based Approach
cp_a.reason: Outlines Singapore's updated National AML Strategy emphasizing a three-pillar framework and its risk-based approach requirements for FIs and DNFBPs.

units.zh: 新加坡于2024年10月更新国家反洗钱战略，强调预防、检测和执法三大支柱框架。
units.en: Singapore's National AML Strategy was updated in October 2024 and outlines its approach to combat money laundering risks, emphasizing a three-pillar framework of prevention, detection, and enforcement.

units.zh: 新加坡要求金融机构和DNFBP实施风险为本的反洗钱/反恐怖融资合规措施，包括客户尽职调查、强化尽职调查、持续交易监控和可疑交易报告。
units.en: Singapore follows a risk-based approach to AML/CFT compliance. This approach requires financial institutions and DNFBPs to implement CDD, enhanced due diligence for high-risk clients, ongoing transaction monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting.

cp_b.title_zh: 国家风险评估：威胁识别与强化措施
cp_b.title_en: National Risk Assessment (NRA): Threats and Enhanced Measures
cp_b.reason: Defines NRA as identifying national-level ML/TF threats and requiring enhanced measures.

units.zh: 国家风险评估识别国家层面的洗钱与恐怖融资威胁和风险，并审查高风险行业
units.en: NRAs identify national-level money laundering and terror financing threats and risks. These assessments review sectors and areas with higher risks.

units.zh: 金融机构必须采取强化措施以缓解风险
units.en: Financial institutions are required to apply enhanced measures to mitigate these risks.

cp_a.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 联合国设立多项倡议推动全球ESG目标
units.en: The UN has established a number of initiatives to advance ESG goals on a global basis.

units.zh: 联合国可持续发展目标提供17项目标框架
units.en: A widely known initiative is its Sustainable Development Goals, which provide a framework of 17 objectives to address poverty, inequality, and environmental threats while promoting peace and prosperity.

units.zh: 其他ESG相关联合国倡议包括UNGP、UNEP FI和UNGC
units.en: Other ESG-related UN initiatives include the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, the UN Environment Program Finance Initiative, and the UN Global Compact, an initiative to encourage businesses to support a wide range of ESG priorities.

units.zh: 所有联合国会员国采纳可持续发展目标
units.en: All UN Member States adopted the goals, and many organizations align their strategies with them.

cp_b.reason: Covers the establishment, oversight role, composition, and ongoing functions of governance committees for transaction monitoring, forming a unified review point on committee-based governance.

units.zh: 机构建立治理委员会以确保选择正确的场景和方法。
units.en: To ensure they select the right scenarios and apply appropriate methodologies, institutions establish governance committees, such as for model risk governance.

units.zh: 治理委员会确保交易监控规则有效、公平、准确，并定期评估和更新
units.en: Governance committees help maintain effective, fair, and accurate transaction monitoring rules. These committees regularly assess whether existing rules align with evolving financial crime trends, regulatory expectations, and emerging money laundering techniques. Governance committees also review, approve, and validate initial and ongoing scenario development, tuning, and turning off outdated or ineffective scenarios.

units.zh: 金融机构进行风险评估后设计反洗钱系统以实施交易监控规则和模型。
units.en: After financial institutions conduct risk assessments, they design AML systems to mitigate the threats they have identified by implementing transaction monitoring rules and models.

units.zh: 治理委员会监督规则选择、实施和系统更新
units.en: These committees oversee rule selection, implementation, and system updates.

units.zh: 治理委员会由业务、产品、风控、合规等多方组成
units.en: They typically include business leaders, product managers, customer relationship teams, risk management professionals, compliance officers, and auditors in addition to model risk experts to ensure broad oversight.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Typical contents of internal AFC reports

cp_a.reason: Focuses solely on the Level 2 investigation stage, including its definition and the list of analytical activities performed; this is a distinct review topic within the section.

units.zh: 二级审查（调查阶段）对警报和数据进行详细分析以判断是否指向金融犯罪
units.en: During the Level 2 review, or investigation stage, analysts perform a detailed analysis of the alert and data from the initial review to establish whether the unusual behavior could indicate a financial crime. This stage typically includes:

units.zh: 分析交易模式和频率
units.en: Analyzing transaction patterns and frequency.

units.zh: 评估资金来源和去向
units.en: Assessing the source and destination of funds.

units.zh: 审查了解你的客户信息和客户风险画像
units.en: Reviewing KYC information and the customer risk profile.

units.zh: 收集额外记录，如客户与机构沟通记录及既往调查信息
units.en: Gathering additional records, such as communication logs between the customer and institution, and any prior investigations related to the customer or account.

units.zh: 开展开源研究，包括社交媒体、新闻、公共记录及监管机构发布的警报和指引
units.en: Conducting open-source research to include social media, news articles, public records and notices, alerts, or guidance issued by law enforcement and regulatory agencies, to inform their opinion on the escalated activity.

units.zh: 分析师基于收集的数据判定活动是否可疑并提供充分理由
units.en: Analysts then determine whether the activity is suspicious, providing a robust rationale based on the data collected.

cp_b.title_zh: 内部金融犯罪防控报告的典型内容
cp_b.title_en: Typical contents of internal AFC reports
cp_b.reason: Groups the components of internal AFC reports into one review point for easy recall of what such reports include.

units.zh: 关键风险指标是评估金融犯罪防控风险的定量和定性指标
units.en: Key risk indicators (KRI) are quantitative and qualitative metrics assessing AFC risks, including suspicious transaction volumes and trends, due diligence review backlog, and monitoring system deficiencies.

units.zh: 关键绩效指标衡量金融犯罪防控控制有效性，如可疑活动报告提交时限、误报率等
units.en: Key performance indicators (KPI) are measures of AFC control effectiveness, such as SAR filing timelines, false positive reduction rates in screening, and alert resolution times.

units.zh: 监管合规更新应包括新金融犯罪防控法规、执法趋势和新兴风险的摘要
units.en: Regulatory and compliance updates should include summaries of new AFC regulations, enforcement trends, and emerging risks, to ensure that policies remain aligned with current legal obligations. Horizon scanning for emerging risks and trends is particularly important because it requires considerable lead time and resource planning.

units.zh: 内部金融犯罪防控报告通常包含以下内容
units.en: Internal AFC reports usually contain:

units.zh: 监管检查报告、审计发现和内部风险评估报告包括合规差距和纠正措施跟踪
units.en: Regulatory examination reports, audit findings, and internal risk assessments: Reports on regulatory examination preparation and findings, internal and external audit outcomes, identified compliance gaps, and corrective action tracking.

units.zh: 高风险客户和交易报告包括准入决策和尽职调查评估，委员会可就是否接纳或退出客户发表意见
units.en: High-risk customer and transaction reports include assessments of onboarding decisions and due diligence. In some cases, committees might express opinions on whether to onboard or exit a particular customer based on risk profiles and other factors.
